title: Invoices group into one asset row per vehicle record, with a snapshot fallback for older invoices with no vehicle id
custom_preconds: 1. A customer has two or more invoices on the SAME vehicle record and at least one invoice on a different vehicle (seed ZZAUTOTEST data).
custom_steps:
1. Expand the customer.
2. Count the asset rows and compare each asset's invoice count with the invoices you created.
3. If the environment has an older invoice with no vehicle record linked (only a stored vehicle snapshot), check which asset row it lands under.
custom_expected:
1. Invoices referencing the same vehicle record (same vehicle id) group into ONE asset row — no duplicate rows for the same vehicle.
2. An older invoice with no vehicle id on file groups by the invoice's own stored vehicle snapshot instead.
